t2.title: Employers be allowed to monitor employees' emails and internet use at…
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should employers be allowed to monitor employees' emails and internet use at work?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Workplace monitoring has become increasingly common in the digital age. While I understand employers' concerns, I believe strict monitoring should be limited.

Firstly, some monitoring may be justified for security reasons. Companies need to protect sensitive data and prevent employees from accessing inappropriate content. Additionally, monitoring can ensure staff remain productive during working hours.

However, excessive monitoring creates a culture of distrust and negatively impacts employee morale. Workers who feel constantly watched experience higher stress levels and lower job satisfaction. This can actually reduce productivity rather than improve it.

Moreover, employees have a right to reasonable privacy, even at work. Personal emails and occasional internet browsing during breaks should not be scrutinized.

A balanced approach would be implementing transparent policies that inform employees about what is monitored. Companies should focus on results and performance rather than surveillance.

In conclusion, while some monitoring is acceptable, employers should respect employee privacy and build trust rather than relying on constant surveillance.

t2.sampleB2: This is a really interesting question, and I think it's one worth talking through properly. To be fair, I can see where employers are coming from. Businesses need to protect sensitive data and make sure company time isn't wasted, so a certain amount of monitoring makes sense — especially when it comes to security. That said, I don't think bosses should have free rein to watch everything. If people feel like they're being spied on all day, trust breaks down and morale takes a hit. Nobody works well under that kind of pressure, and honestly, it can end up doing more harm than good. For me, the answer lies in being upfront. Companies should spell out exactly what they monitor and why, rather than snooping behind people's backs. As long as the rules are clear and staff know where they stand, most people won't mind. At the end of the day, it's about striking a balance between security and privacy. What do you all think — would you be comfortable knowing your employer could read your emails? I'd love to hear your take on this.
t2.uzSample:
Ish joyida kuzatuv raqamli davrda tobora keng tarqalib bormoqda. Ish beruvchilarning xavotirlarini tushunsam ham, menimcha, qattiq nazorat cheklangan bo'lishi kerak.

Birinchidan, xavfsizlik sabablari tufayli ba'zi kuzatuvlar oqlanishi mumkin. Kompaniyalar maxfiy ma'lumotlarni himoya qilishlari va xodimlarning nomaqbul kontentga kirishini oldini olishlari kerak. Bundan tashqari, kuzatuv xodimlarning ish vaqtida unumli bo'lishini ta'minlashi mumkin.

Biroq, haddan tashqari kuzatuv ishonchsizlik muhitini yaratadi va xodimlarning kayfiyatiga salbiy ta'sir qiladi. Doimiy ravishda kuzatuv ostida ekanligini his qilgan ishchilar yuqori stress darajasini va ishdan kamroq qoniqishni his qilishadi. Bu aslida unumdorlikni oshirish o'rniga kamaytirishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, xodimlar hatto ishda ham oqilona maxfiylik huquqiga ega. Shaxsiy elektron pochta xabarlari va tanaffuslar paytida vaqti-vaqti bilan internetda ko'rish tekshirilmasligi kerak.

Muvozanatli yondashuv xodimlarni nima kuzatilayotgani haqida xabardor qiladigan shaffof siyosatlarni amalga oshirish bo'ladi. Kompaniyalar kuzatuvga emas, balki natijalarga va ishlashga e'tibor qaratishlari kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, ba'zi kuzatuvlar maqbul bo'lsa-da, ish beruvchilar doimiy kuzatuvga tayanmasdan, xodimlarning maxfiyligini hurmat qilishlari va ishonchni mustahkamlashlari kerak.

Hurmat bilan,
Muattar Karimova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the music streaming service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear MelodyStream Support, Thank you for asking about my experience with your streaming service. I have been using MelodyStream for three months and am thoroughly impressed. The audio quality is excellent, and the personalized playlists consistently introduce me to new artists I love. The app is extremely user-friendly and works seamlessly across all my devices. However, I have noticed some areas for improvement. Firstly, the offline download limit is quite restrictive. I would appreciate more storage for downloaded tracks. Secondly, the lyrics feature is not available for all songs, which is disappointing. Additionally, I would love to see a collaborative playlist feature where friends can add songs together. Overall, MelodyStream has become essential to my daily routine and I would recommend it to anyone. Yours sincerely, Muattar Karimova

t12.sampleA2:

t12.sampleB1:
Dear MelodyStream Support,

Thank you for your email. I like MelodyStream. The music is good and the app is easy to use. I like the playlists, but I think they could be better. For example, I like rock music, but the rock playlist has a lot of pop music. Also, sometimes the music stops. I think you should fix this.

In my opinion, MelodyStream is good, but it could be better.

Thank you,
Muattar Karimova
t12.sampleB2: Dear MelodyStream Support, Thank you for getting in touch about my experience with your Premium subscription. On the whole, I have been thoroughly impressed since I signed up three months ago. Your playlist recommendations are remarkably accurate and have introduced me to a host of new artists I now listen to daily. The audio quality is crisp and reliable, and I find the app straightforward to navigate, even on the move. That said, there is still room for improvement. I would greatly appreciate a more generous offline download limit, as the current cap feels rather restrictive. In addition, a collaborative playlist feature — allowing friends to build playlists together — would be a fantastic addition. Overall, MelodyStream has quickly become part of my daily routine, and I would happily recommend it to others. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova

Bundan tashqari, do'stlar birgalikda qo'shiq qo'sha oladigan hamkorlikdagi pleylist funksiyasini ko'rishni juda xohlardim.
